profiles.baseline: Line 6–7 out of service; same wind availability and demand.
assumptions: Hypothetical wind at bus 6, with the same availability in both cases.
Published case limits remain unchanged. Original demand scales uniformly by the selected load factor.
The objective includes an explicit synthetic wind-curtailment penalty. It is not an electricity tariff.
limitations: Results apply to this benchmark and declared steady-state checks. They do not measure Irish curtailment.
No full N-1, dynamic stability, protection, switching or maintenance approval is established.
A converged AC optimum is not a proof of a global optimum.

profiles.name: Original Irish case · Source audit
profiles.description: Original EirGrid planning snapshot and archived conversion diagnosis. The legacy comparison has been superseded; use the conditional study for the new checked experiment.
profiles.baseline: Requested wind injection with line 1341–1701 out of service.
assumptions: Additional hypothetical wind at Binbane 110 kV; equal active-power reduction at the stated Aghada generator.
Consumer demand remains 7,324.51 MW. No historical 2026 replay is claimed.
limitations: The source itself contains 173 voltage-limit violations below 100 kV. Counterfactuals also contain violations.
Ideal bus ties, rounded source voltages and simplified controls require careful interpretation. Read the diagnostic report.
Results are not eligible for an approved-operation or verified-curtailment-saving claim.

profiles.name: Irish planning study · 20 MW flexibility
profiles.description: Same demand and network outage, different connection points for hypothetical 20 MW flexible demand. Verified stored snapshots; use Robustness & value for other tested conditions.
profiles.baseline: 20 MW flexible demand at bus 2072; same total demand, wind availability, outage and prepared controls.
assumptions: Hypothetical controllable loads at the two named buses. No real data-centre capacity or permission was supplied.
Both alternatives use a derived planning case with declared tap changes and a capacitor disconnection. The original RAW case is not feasible under all its own limits.
The source file is a public transmission planning model, not a measured dispatch-down time series.
Aghada bus 10470 balances changes. HVDC import remains a calibrated fixed boundary; source local voltage targets are held fixed.
limitations: This is a conditional model experiment, not measured Irish savings or an instruction to move a real load.
Best tested points within 0–200 MW; search is not certified globally optimal. Refinement interval is at most 0.25 MW.
The original ratings are preserved, including zero and very large placeholder-like ratings. Actual equipment capability still needs confirmation.
144 ideal tree-tie flows pass the recovery check; four cyclic tie flows use an explicit inverse-reactance allocation, not a unique measured split.
No N-1, dynamics, inertia/SNSP, protection, switching permission, tariff, site SLA or intertemporal device feasibility was established.
The snapshot cannot establish avoided MWh, profit, or a percentage of Ireland-wide curtailment.
AI did not produce this result. Deterministic calculations and verification produced it. Live Microsoft AI remains untested.
